```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pyhere import here
```

```{python}
phot_colspecs = [
    (0, 4),    # YB
    (5, 14),   # GLON
    (15, 23),  # GLAT
    (24, 31),  # MWPR
    (60, 68),  # F8
    (69, 77),  # e_F8
    (78, 85),  # F12
    (86, 94),  # e_F12
    (95, 102), # F24
    (103, 110),# e_F24
    (111, 120),# F70
    (121, 130),# e_F70
    (131, 133),# N8
    (134, 136),# N12
    (137, 139),# N24
    (140, 141),# N70
    (142, 146),# f_SAT
    (147, 148),# f_MULTI
    (149, 153),# f_NOSRC
    (154, 158),# f_PCONF
    (159, 160),# f_CEXT
]
phot_colnames = [
    "YB", "GLON", "GLAT", "MWPR",
    "F8", "e_F8", "F12", "e_F12", "F24", "e_F24", "F70", "e_F70",
    "N8", "N12", "N24", "N70",
    "f_SAT", "f_MULTI", "f_NOSRC", "f_PCONF", "f_CEXT"
]
phot = pd.read_fwf(
    here("data", "MRT-phot.txt"),
    colspecs=phot_colspecs,
    names=phot_colnames,
    skiprows=38,
    encoding='utf-8-sig',
    dtype={'f_SAT': str, 'f_PCONF': str, 'f_NOSRC': str},
    na_values=[999.0000]
)
phot.head()
```

```{python}
phot['f_SAT_F8'] = phot['f_SAT'].str[0].astype(int)
phot['f_SAT_F12'] = phot['f_SAT'].str[1].astype(int)
phot['f_SAT_F24'] = phot['f_SAT'].str[2].astype(int)
phot['f_SAT_F70'] = phot['f_SAT'].str[3].astype(int)
phot['f_NOSRC_F8'] = phot['f_NOSRC'].str[0].astype(int)
phot['f_NOSRC_F12'] = phot['f_NOSRC'].str[1].astype(int)
phot['f_NOSRC_F24'] = phot['f_NOSRC'].str[2].astype(int)
phot['f_NOSRC_F70'] = phot['f_NOSRC'].str[3].astype(int)
phot['f_PCONF_F8'] = phot['f_PCONF'].str[0].astype(int)
phot['f_PCONF_F12'] = phot['f_PCONF'].str[1].astype(int)
phot['f_PCONF_F24'] = phot['f_PCONF'].str[2].astype(int)
phot['f_PCONF_F70'] = phot['f_PCONF'].str[3].astype(int)
phot.head()
```

```{python}
phot['F8'].describe()
```

```{python}
phot.loc[phot['f_SAT_F8'] == 1, 'F8'] = np.nan
phot.loc[phot['f_SAT_F12'] == 1, 'F12'] = np.nan
phot.loc[phot['f_SAT_F24'] == 1, 'F24'] = np.nan
phot.loc[phot['f_SAT_F70'] == 1, 'F70'] = np.nan
phot.loc[phot['f_NOSRC_F8'] == 1, 'F8'] = np.nan
phot.loc[phot['f_NOSRC_F12'] == 1, 'F12'] = np.nan
phot.loc[phot['f_NOSRC_F24'] == 1, 'F24'] = np.nan
phot.loc[phot['f_NOSRC_F70'] == 1, 'F70'] = np.nan
phot.loc[phot['f_PCONF_F8'] == 1, 'F8'] = np.nan
phot.loc[phot['f_PCONF_F12'] == 1, 'F12'] = np.nan
phot.loc[phot['f_PCONF_F24'] == 1, 'F24'] = np.nan
phot.loc[phot['f_PCONF_F70'] == 1, 'F70'] = np.nan
phot.loc[559, 'F12'] = np.nan
phot.loc[2318, 'F12'] = np.nan

phot['F12'].describe()
```

```{python}
phot = phot.drop(columns=[
    'f_SAT_F8',
    'f_SAT_F12',
    'f_SAT_F24',
    'f_SAT_F70',
    'f_NOSRC_F8',
    'f_NOSRC_F12',
    'f_NOSRC_F24',
    'f_NOSRC_F70',
    'f_PCONF_F8',
    'f_PCONF_F12',
    'f_PCONF_F24',
    'f_PCONF_F70',
    'GLON',
    'GLAT',
    'MWPR'
    ]
)
```

## making final "master" dataset for final models that can be trimmed within scripts

```{python}
dist_colspecs = [
    (0, 4),    #ID 
   (5, 10),    #DIST 
  (11, 16),    #e_DIST      
  (17, 22),    #DIST_C	 
  (23, 29),    #DIST_M 
  (30, 36),    #e_DIST_M  
  (37, 48),    #STAT_M   
  (49, 53),    #PFAR 
  (54, 59),    #DIST_R1   
  (60, 65),    #e_DIST_R1
  (66, 70),    #PINT_R1
  (71, 76),    #ARM_R1
  (77, 82),    #DIST_R2
  (83, 87),    #e_DIST_R2   
  (88, 92),    #PINT_R2   
  (93, 98)     #ARM_R2
]
dist_colnames = ['YB', 'DIST', 'e_DIST', 'DIST_C', 'DIST_M', 'e_DIST_M', 'STAT_M', 'PFAR', 'DIST_R1', 'e_DIST_R1', 'PINT_R1', 'ARM_R1', 'DIST_R2', 'e_DIST_R2', 'PINT_R2', 'ARM_R2']
print(len(dist_colnames), len(dist_colspecs))
dist = pd.read_fwf(
    here("data", "MRT-dist.txt"),
    colspecs=dist_colspecs,
    names=dist_colnames,
    skiprows=28,
    encoding='utf-8-sig',
    na_values=[999.0000]
)
dist.head()
dist = dist.drop(columns = ['e_DIST', 'DIST_C', 'DIST_M', 'e_DIST_M', 'STAT_M', 'PFAR', 'DIST_R1', 'e_DIST_R1', 'PINT_R1', 'ARM_R1', 'DIST_R2', 'e_DIST_R2', 'PINT_R2', 'ARM_R2'])
```

```{python}
mirion = pd.read_csv(here('data/cleaned', 'MIRION_cleaned_all_fluxes.csv'))
mirion = mirion.drop(columns = ['F8', 'F12', 'F24', 'F70'])
phot_read = pd.read_csv(here('data/cleaned', 'MIRION_phot_cleaned.csv'))
phot_read = phot_read.drop(columns=['f_SAT', 'f_NOSRC', 'f_PCONF'])
```

```{python}
total_data = pd.merge(mirion, dist, on='YB', how='inner')
total_data = pd.merge(total_data, phot_read, on='YB', how='left')
```

```{python}
total_data.to_csv(here('data/cleaned', 'MIRION_cleaned_everything.csv'))
```
